title: Minimum Operations to Exceed Threshold Value I
summary: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, determine the least number of operations required to ensure all elements in nums are at least k by removing the smallest element in each operation.
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, determine the least number of operations required to ensure all elements in nums are at least k by removing the smallest element in each operation.
constraints: One operation removes one array value strictly less than k.
Continue until every remaining value is at least k.
Return the minimum number of operations.
reference_solution:
def operations_to_exceed_threshold(nums,k):
    return sum(value<k for value in nums)
hints: Every below-threshold value must disappear, and removing it once is sufficient.
No operation is needed for a value already at least k.
Count the values strictly less than k.
This count is both a lower bound and an achievable removal plan, so it is minimal.
editorial: This count is both a lower bound and an achievable removal plan, so it is minimal.
